name: Sa Corruption
source:
[Mental Channel Open]
Hey?
Someone's there?
I need your help.

YOU must help Nuri escape the evil version of the strange hotel called “Lovers' Eden”, while keeping a close eye to hir “Corruption”.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/982770/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
【心灵通道开启】嘿？
有人在吗？
我需要你的帮助。

你必须帮助努里逃离邪恶版的名为“情人伊甸园”的奇怪酒店，同时密切关注他的“腐败”。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/982770/]Steam[/url]]
